title: DBS CEO cites FCNR(B) success as proof of global faith in India, calls for more FDI
description: DBS Bank CEO Tan Su Shan addressed concerns about capital outflows from India and highlighted strong demand for FCNR(B) deposits. She emphasized the need for more foreign direct investment and exports to support the rupee's stability. Tan expressed optimism about India's potential in artificial intelligence due to its software talent and digital infrastructure developments. The importance of improving hardware capabilities alongside software strengths was also noted in her discussion.
